config.name: traffic-blocking-notification-msg
value:
Notice

To access the network, you must first connect to GlobalProtect.

config.name: captive-portal-detection-msg
value:
Captive Portal Detected

GlobalProtect has temporarily permitted network access for you to connect to the Internet. Follow instructions from your internet provider.

If you let the connection time out, open GlobalProtect and click Connect to try again.

config.name: mfa-notification-msg
value: You have attempted to access a protected resource that requires additional authentication. Proceed to authenticate at

config.name: quarantine-add-message
value: Access to the network from this device has been restricted as per your organization's security policy. Please contact your IT Administrator.

config.name: quarantine-remove-message
value: Access to the network from this device has been restored as per your organization's security policy.
